newsitem.title: USA: Boca Research sees Q4 net $0.03/shr.
newsitem.headline: Boca Research sees Q4 net $0.03/shr.

text.p: Boca Research Inc said on Monday it expects to post fourth quarter net income of $0.03 per share.
In the prior year's fourth quarter, the company reported net income of $0.32 per share.
Boca Research said the per-share figures reflect continued modem product pricing pressures, industry-wide excess inventory among other issues.

In addition, Boca said its expenses were $660,000 higher than previously expected in the quarter, which ended December 31. Those expenses include a new emphasis on retail, as well as the acquisition of Creatix Polymedia GmbH.
The company expects fourth quarter revenues of about $29 million, it said.
Its fourth quarter results are to be reported in early or mid February.
